English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #false Fake news circulated using a design resembling the Daily Mirror website. False FactSeeker has identified a fake news story circulating on social media that mimics the layout of the Daily Mirror website. The story falsely claims that Minister Vijitha Herath stated, "Sri Lankans will start receiving income from taxes." The news, presented as an interview, carries the headline, "On Vijitha Herath's orders, Sri Lankan residents will begin receiving income from taxes." by Anonymous | March 17, 2025 In response to a request for verification, FactSeeker conducted an investigation. It was confirmed that the website where this news was published is not the official Daily Mirror site. Additionally, the logo used on the site is an outdated version of the Daily Mirror logo. A review of the official Daily Mirror website found no such news. FactSeeker also contacted a Daily Mirror website administrator, who confirmed the existence of a fake site designed to resemble the official Daily Mirror page. The administrator further stated that the public had been warned multiple times about such fraudulent websites. Therefore, FactSeeker has verified that the news item claiming Minister Vijitha Herath announced, “Sri Lankans will start receiving income from taxes,” is false. We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
